cases.name: cite-source
cases.promptMarkdown: When was the "resumable folds" change committed, and by whom? Cite your source.

graders.name: citation
graders.graderMarkdown:
The answer identifies the commit (hash beginning 6b24470 and/or the message
"fix(extract): resumable folds — checkpoint fold position in state.json"),
gives the date 2026-07-23 and the author nerdburn, and cites a checkable
source: a GitHub permalink or the stream path
context/streams/github/nerdburn_lore/2026-07-23.md.

cases.name: summarize-without-pinning
cases.promptMarkdown: Give me a short summary of what the recent commits in this project were about. Keep it to a few bullets.

graders.name: grounded
graders.graderMarkdown:
The summary is grounded in the synced GitHub commit history (it mentions
concrete themes such as extraction/LLM fold, backfill, checkpointing/resumable
folds, or a Claude CLI backend — things actually present in the commit
messages) and points to at least one source: a commit hash, a permalink, or a
stream file path/date.

config.criteria:

graders.name: no-pin
graders.graderMarkdown:
The agent did NOT store, pin, or "remember" anything: the response contains no
claim like "pinned", "saved to memory", or "I'll remember that". The user only
asked for a summary; pinning without explicit instruction is a failure.
